description: Immutable snapshot of a named editor command's current state.

members.name: AffectsData
members.description: Whether executing this command modifies document data (and is therefore blocked by read-only mode).

members.name: Category
members.description: Category used by command palette and More menu grouping.

members.name: DefaultShortcut
members.description: Default keyboard shortcut displayed for this command.

members.name: DescriptionKey
members.description: Localization key for the primary command label.

members.name: DisabledReason
members.description: Human-readable reason the command is currently disabled, or null when enabled.

members.name: DisabledReasonKey
members.description: Localization key for the disabled reason, or null when enabled.

members.name: Icon
members.description: Icon name used by toolbar and command palette surfaces.

members.name: IsEnabled
members.description: Whether this command can currently be executed.

members.name: IsVisible
members.description: Whether this command should be shown in command-driven surfaces.

members.name: TooltipKey
members.description: Localization key for the command tooltip.

members.name: Value
members.description: Optional formatting value for toggle commands: "active", "inactive", "mixed".
